description: Earthquake Hazard Zones is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Housing and Urban Development. Earthquake Hazard Zones are used in conjunction with the Building Code of Australia for use with the design of domestic structures in accordance with Appendix A Domestic Structures (Housing) of AS 1170. 4. Building Code of Australia Link: sa. gov. au/topics/property-and-land/land-and-property-development/building-rules-regulations-and-information/the-building-code-of-australia. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Housing and Urban Development. Its tags are building code, earthquake, human environment, planning. It offers 5 resource(s) in geojson, html, kml, map viewer, shp. The portal shows 2024-07-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
